ios.desc:
The baby name matcher that helps you decide together. Neimr lets couples swipe through baby names, find matches, and pick the perfect name — like a name generator powered by you and your partner.

Whether you need a baby name app for couples, a pet name finder, or a business name generator — Neimr makes naming together simple and fun.

HOW IT WORKS
- Create a naming session and invite anyone with a simple code
- Swipe through curated name suggestions (right to like, left to pass)
- See your matches in Results once you both like the same name
- Review your favorites and decide together

BABY NAME MATCHER
Forget endless debates and disagreements. With Neimr, finding a baby name everyone loves becomes an engaging experience. Swipe through names on your own time, and let the app reveal your matches. It's like a dating app for baby names!

NAMES FOR EVERY OCCASION
- Baby Names: Find the perfect name for your little one with your partner, family, or friends
- Pet Names: Discover adorable names for dogs, cats, and furry friends
- Business Names: Brainstorm brand and company names with your co-founder
- Boat Names: Find the perfect vessel name with family
- Character Names: Writers can crowdsource names for stories and games
- Nicknames: Fun pet names and gamertags with friends

POWERFUL FEATURES
- Style Filters: Traditional, Modern, Unique, Nordic, and more
- Name Details: Meanings, origins, and popularity trends
- Surname Compatibility: See how names sound with your last name
- Super Likes: Mark your absolute favorites
- Shared Matches: See every name you both liked
- Save & Organize: Keep track of names you love
- Multi-participant: Invite more than just your partner

FLEXIBLE FREE TIER
Get started free with:
- 1 active session
- 2 participants
- 80 names per list
- 5 super likes
- 1 undo per session
- Baby & Pet categories

PREMIUM UNLOCKS
Go premium for unlimited sessions, unlimited participants, all categories, unlimited super likes, and an ad-free experience.

WHY NEIMR?
Neimr is built for couples choosing a baby name. Swipe on your own time, see the names you both liked, and decide together. The same swiping works for pet names with the family and, with Premium, for business names, nicknames and more.

Download Neimr and start finding names everyone will love!

I also just shipped two more apps today:

- Biblewise — a Bible trivia game I originally built for my niece and nephew but ended up  with three modes: adventure (progressive levels across 6 categories), daily challenges with streak tracking, and a timed mode. Built with SwiftUI + SwiftData, offline-first. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/biblewise-bible-quiz-game/id6758916009

- Neimr — a collaborative naming app with Tinder-style swiping. Create a survey for baby names, pet names, business names, etc., invite your partner/friends, and it finds which names you all agree on. Built with Flutter + Firebase. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/neimr-find-names-together/id6758278121

Following up the comment i made last month, I'm a solo dev building a handful of apps across different niches.

- Linetris ( https://apps.apple.com/us/app/linetris-daily-line-puzzle/id6759858457 ), a daily puzzle game where you fill an 8x8 grid with Tetris-like pieces to clear lines. Think Wordle meets Tetris. Daily challenges, leaderboards, and competititve play against friends.

- Kvile ( https://kvile.app ) — A lightweight desktop HTTP client built with Rust + Tauri. Native .http file support (JetBrains/VS Code/Kulala compatible), Monaco editor, JS pre/post scripts, SQLite-backed history. Sub-second startup. MIT licensed, no cloud, your requests stay on your machine. Think Postman without the bloat and login walls.

- Mockingjay ( https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mockingjay-secure-recorder/id6758616261 ) — iOS app that records video and streams AES-256-GCM encrypted chunks to your Google Drive in real-time. By the time someone takes your phone, the footage is already safe in the cloud. Built for journalists, activists, and anyone who needs tamper-proof evidence. Features a duress PIN that wipes local keys while preserving cloud backups, and a fake sleep mode that makes the phone look powered off during recording.

- Stao ( https://stao.app ) — A simple sit/stand reminder for standing desk users. Runs in the system tray, tracks your streaks, zero setup. Available on macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android.
